relations.reason: Harvested patterns are the input that adaptation applies. Harvest discovers what to learn; adapt updates behavior.
Individual extraction events produce raw data that harvesting aggregates into patterns over time.
Human edits — what they change and what they leave unchanged — are the primary behavioral signal.
AI-discovered patterns are prone to hallucination; verify against source material before applying.
Low-confidence patterns should be staged for human review before affecting system behavior.

Cluster groups items by similarity in a vector space at a single point in time; Harvest discovers patterns from sequential human decisions over time. Cluster is spatial (which items are near each other); Harvest is temporal (what behaviors recur across decisions). Cluster needs embeddings; Harvest needs behavioral logs with provenance.

entries.definitionZh: Contrast描述了字体的粗细部分之间的中风宽度差. 数值为0表示没有可见/明显对比. 一个正数表明,相对于通过使细中风变薄而实现的零相位厚度而言,相对增高. 值为100表示细中风已完全消失. 一个负值表示"反向对比":在写作系统中通常会厚的划线反而变薄. 在西语字体中,这可能被认为是19世纪的一种"circus"或"old West"效应. 数值为 -100 表示通常厚的中风已完全消失。
entries.sourceDefinition: Contrast describes the stroke width difference between the thick and thin parts of the font glyphs. A value of zero indicates no visible/apparent contrast. A positive number indicates an increase in contrast relative to the zero-contrast thickness, achieved by making the thin stroke thinner. A value of 100 indicates that the thin stroke has disappeared completely. A negative value indicates "reverse contrast": the strokes which would conventionally be thick in the writing system are instead made thinner. In western-language fonts this might be perceived as a 19th-century, "circus" or "old West" effect. A value of -100 indicates that the strokes which would normally be thick have disappeared completely.

entries.sourceDefinition: The @charset CSS rule specifies the character encoding used in the style sheet. This syntax is useful when using non-ASCII characters in some CSS properties, like content. Although the first character in @charset is the @ symbol, it is not an at-rule. It is a specific byte sequence that can only be placed at the very beginning of a stylesheet. No other characters, except the Unicode byte-order mark, are allowed before it. It also does not follow normal CSS syntax rules such as use of quotes or whitespace.

entries.definitionZh: 轮播通过顺序显示一张或多张幻灯片的子集来呈现一组项目（称为幻灯片）。通常，一次显示一张幻灯片，用户可以激活下一张或上一张幻灯片控件，该控件隐藏当前幻灯片并将下一张或上一张幻灯片“旋转”到视图中。在一些实现中，旋转在页面加载时自动开始，并且也可以在所有幻灯片显示完毕后自动停止。虽然幻灯片可以包含任何类型的内容，但每张幻灯片仅包含单个图像的图像轮播很常见。
entries.sourceDefinition: A carousel presents a set of items, referred to as slides, by sequentially displaying a subset of one or more slides. Typically, one slide is displayed at a time, and users can activate a next or previous slide control that hides the current slide and "rotates" the next or previous slide into view. entries.definitionZh: 网格小部件是一个容器，使用户能够使用方向导航键（例如箭头键、 Home 和 End ）来导航其包含的信息或交互元素。作为提供灵活键盘导航的通用容器小部件，它可以满足各种需求。它可以用于简单的用途，例如对复选框或导航链接的集合进行分组，也可以用于复杂的用途，例如创建功能齐全的电子表格应用程序。虽然在描述和呈现具有网格角色的元素的逻辑结构时，WAI-ARIA 属性的名称和辅助技术中使用了“行”和“列”这两个词，但在元素上使用网格角色并不一定意味着其视觉呈现是表格形式的。
entries.sourceDefinition: A grid widget is a container that enables users to navigate the information or interactive elements it contains using directional navigation keys, such as arrow keys, Home , and End . As a generic container widget that offers flexible keyboard navigation, it can serve a wide variety of needs. It can be used for purposes as simple as grouping a collection of checkboxes or navigation links or as complex as creating a full-featured spreadsheet application. While the words "row" and "column" are used in the names of WAI-ARIA attributes and by assistive technologies when describing and presenting the logical structure of elements with the grid role, using the grid role on an element does not necessarily imply that its visual presentation is tabular.

entries.definitionZh: 弹出窗口是一段短暂的 UI，它在所有其他 Web 应用程序 UI 上“弹出”，即“在顶层”。弹出窗口可以是它自己的独立元素（例如教学气泡），也可以是更大的复合组件（例如组合框）的一部分。弹出窗口与其他顶层 UI 的不同之处在于，它们本质上是瞬态的：一次只能显示一个，除非通过祖先链接，并且弹出窗口会在“轻微关闭”用户交互时关闭（例如，将焦点移出弹出窗口或按 ESC 键）。它们可以包含任意内容，包括交互式后代。
entries.sourceDefinition: A popup is a piece of transient UI that “pops up” over all other web app UI, i.e. “on the top layer”. A popup may be its own standalone element (such as a teaching bubble) or it may be part of a larger composited component (such as a combobox). Popups differ from other top-layer UI in that they are inherently transient: only one can be shown at a time unless chained by ancestry, and popups are dismissed upon “light dismiss” user interactions (e.g. sending focus out of the popup or hitting the ESC key). They can contain arbitrary content, including interactive descendents.

In many two-thumb sliders, the thumbs are not allowed to pass one another, such as when the slider sets the minimum and maximum values for a range. For example, in a price range selector, the maximum value of the thumb that sets the lower end of the range is limited by the current value of the thumb that sets the upper end of the range. Conversely, the minimum value of the upper end thumb is limited by the current value of the lower end thumb. However, in some multi-thumb sliders, each thumb sets a value that does not depend on the other thumb values.

entries.definitionZh: : 残疾 CSS 伪类代表任何已禁用的元素. 一个元素如果无法被激活(选择,点击,输入等)或接受焦点,则被禁用. 该元素还具有被启用状态,在这种状态下可以启动或接受焦点.

entries.sourceDefinition: The :empty CSS pseudo-class represents any element that has no children. Children can be either element nodes or text (including whitespace). Comments, processing instructions, and CSS content do not affect whether an element is considered empty.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The :empty CSS pseudo-class represents any element that has no children. Children can be either element nodes or text (including whitespace). Comments, processing instructions, and CSS content do not affect whether an element is considered empty.

entries.definitionZh: : 启用的 CSS 伪类代表任何启用的元素. 如果一个元素可以被激活(选中、点击、输入等)或接受焦点,则启用。 该元素还具有一个禁用状态,在这种状态下它不能被激活或接受焦点.
entries.sourceDefinition: The :enabled CSS pseudo-class represents any enabled element. An element is enabled if it can be activated (selected, clicked on, typed into, etc.) or accept focus. The element also has a disabled state, in which it can't be activated or accept focus.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The :enabled CSS pseudo-class represents any enabled element. An element is enabled if it can be activated (selected, clicked on, typed into, etc.) or accept focus. The element also has a disabled state, in which it can't be activated or accept focus.

entries.definitionZh: 焦点 CSS 假类代表了一个已经获得焦点的元素(如窗体输入). 通常在用户点击或点击某个元素或用键盘的 Tab 键选择某个元素时触发.
entries.sourceDefinition: The :focus CSS pseudo-class represents an element (such as a form input) that has received focus. It is generally triggered when the user clicks or taps on an element or selects it with the keyboard's Tab key.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The :focus CSS pseudo-class represents an element (such as a form input) that has received focus. It is generally triggered when the user clicks or taps on an element or selects it with the keyboard's Tab key.

entries.definitionZh: :焦点可见的伪类适用,而一个元素匹配:焦点伪类,而UA(用户代理)则通过Heuristics决定该元素的焦点应当明显. (许多浏览器在此情况下默认显示"焦点环".
entries.sourceDefinition: The :focus-visible pseudo-class applies while an element matches the :focus pseudo-class and the UA (User Agent) determines via heuristics that the focus should be made evident on the element. (Many browsers show a "focus ring" by default in this case.)

entries.definitionZh: 如果元素或其任何后代被聚焦,CSS伪类中的:焦点匹配元素. 换句话说,它代表着一个本身与:焦点伪类相匹配的元素,或者有一个与:焦点相匹配的后代. (此包括阴树之后代.
entries.sourceDefinition: The :focus-within CSS pseudo-class matches an element if the element or any of its descendants are focused. entries.definitionZh: : fullscreen CSS 伪类匹配当前全屏模式中的每个元素. 如果多个元素已被放入全屏模式, 则选择全部元素 。

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The :fullscreen CSS pseudo-class matches every element that is currently in fullscreen mode. If multiple elements have been put into fullscreen mode, this selects them all.

entries.definitionZh: :future CSS 伪类选择器是一个时间维的伪类,它将匹配任何完全在匹配: current 的元素之后出现的元素. 例如,在WebVTT显示的带字幕的视频中。

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The :future CSS pseudo-class selector is a time-dimensional pseudo-class that will match for any element which appears entirely after an element that matches :current. For example in a video with captions which are being displayed by WebVTT.

entries.definitionZh: 函数 : has() CSS 伪类代表一个元素,如果任何相对选择器作为参数在锁定此元素时至少匹配一个元素。 此伪类通过将相对选择者列表作为参数来选择一个母元素或之前的比比元素的参考元素.
entries.sourceDefinition: The functional :has() CSS pseudo-class represents an element if any of the relative selectors that are passed as an argument match at least one element when anchored against this element. This pseudo-class presents a way of selecting a parent element or a previous sibling element with respect to a reference element by taking a relative selector list as an argument.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The functional :has() CSS pseudo-class represents an element if any of the relative selectors that are passed as an argument match at least one element when anchored against this element. entries.definitionZh: :has-slotted CSS 伪类匹配,当一个位点元素的内容不是空的或者没有使用默认值(更多信息请参见使用模板和位点).

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The :has-slotted CSS pseudo-class matches when the content of a slot element is not empty or not using the default value (see Using templates and slots for more information).

entries.definitionZh: :标题 CSS 假类匹配文档中的所有标题元素。
entries.sourceDefinition: The :heading CSS pseudo-class matches all heading elements in a document.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The :heading CSS pseudo-class matches all heading elements in a document.

entries.definitionZh: :heading () CSS 伪类函数代表所有与逗号分隔的整数列表相匹配的标题元素. 这使得您可以同时在特定标题级别上样式元素,而不是单独匹配和样式.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The :heading() CSS pseudo-class function represents all heading elements whose levels match a comma-separated list of integers. This allows you to style elements at specific heading levels at once, rather than matching and styling them individually.

entries.definitionZh: :host CSS伪类选择包含它内部使用的CSS的阴影DOM的阴影主机——换句话说,这允许您从它的阴影DOM内部选择自定义元素.
entries.sourceDefinition: The :host CSS pseudo-class selects the shadow host of the shadow DOM containing the CSS it is used inside — in other words, this allows you to select a custom element from inside its shadow DOM.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The :host CSS pseudo-class selects the shadow host of the shadow DOM containing the CSS it is used inside — in other words, this allows you to select a custom element from inside its shadow DOM.

entries.definitionZh: :host-context () CSS 伪类允许您根据阴影主机(具有阴影根的元素)及其 DOM 祖先的选择器,在阴影 DOM 内对元素进行不同的样式.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The :host-context() CSS pseudo-class allows you to style elements within a shadow DOM differently based on the selector of the shadow host (the element that has the shadow root) and its DOM ancestors.

entries.definitionZh: :host () CSS 假类函数选择包含其内部使用的 CSS 的阴影 DOM 的阴影主机(这样您就可以从它的阴影 DOM 内部选择一个自定义元素)——但前提是作为函数参数给出的选定器与阴影主机匹配. :host()在阴影DOM外使用时没有效果.
entries.sourceDefinition: The :host() CSS pseudo-class function selects the shadow host of the shadow DOM containing the CSS it is used inside (so you can select a custom element from inside its shadow DOM) — but only if the selector given as the function's parameter matches the shadow host. :host() has no effect when used outside a shadow DOM.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The :host() CSS pseudo-class function selects the shadow host of the shadow DOM containing the CSS it is used inside (so you can select a custom element from inside its shadow DOM) — but only if the selector given as the function's parameter matches the shadow host. :host() has no effect when used outside a shadow DOM.

entries.definitionZh: :hover CSS 假类在用户使用指针设备与其交互时,匹配一个元素. 当用户将光标(mouse pointer)移动到一个元素上而不按鼠标按钮时,通常会触发伪类.
